body.text: A federal judge struck down the ATF “ghost gun” kit rule the Supreme Court upheld 7–2 fifteen months ago — same rule, same judge, same case, different constitutional claims.

Judge Reed O’Connor vacated the ATF rule classifying unfinished frames and receivers sold with jigs and tools as firearms, in Defense Distributed v. Blanche — a continuation of Bondi v. VanDerStok. What changed is the claims, not the rule: VanDerStok was an APA case, while O’Connor decided Fifth Amendment vagueness and Second Amendment history-and-tradition.
